In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''runcinated 24-cell honeycomb''' is a uniform space-filling [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]. It can be seen as a [[Runcination (geometry)|runcination]] of the regular [[24-cell honeycomb]], containing [[runcinated 24-cell]], [[24-cell]], [[octahedral prism]], and 3-3 [[duoprism]] cells. 

== Alternate names==
* Runcinated icositetrachoric tetracomb/honeycomb
* Small prismated icositetrachoric tetracomb (spict)
* Small prismatotetracontaoctachoric tetracomb
